title: Anthropic to make Claude Code auto mode the default
summary: From Aug 14, Claude Code on Pro, Max and Team plans will act without asking approval unless an action is irreversible or destructive.
reason: Agents given more default autonomy over code.

title: Moody's warns banks' reliance on few AI providers is a systemic risk
summary: Moody's said concentration on a handful of cloud and AI vendors exposes banks to outages, cyber failures and pricing pressure, citing Lloyds.
